description.zh: 结束时间，与timeType结合使用。格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
description.en: The end time. This parameter is used together with TimeType. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
The order ID. This parameter is optional.

description.zh:
订单来源：
- 0 普通客户
- 1 企业客户
- 2 二级经销商
description.en:
The order source. Valid values:
- 0: regular customer.
- 1: enterprise customer.
- 2: secondary reseller.

description.zh:
订单状态：
- 1 未支付
- 2 已废弃
- 3 已支付
description.en:
The order status. Valid values:
- 1: unpaid.
- 2: canceled.
- 3: paid.

description.zh:
订单类型:
- BUY: 新购
- UPGRADE: 升级
- DOWNGRADE: 降级
- RENEW: 续费
- REFUND: 退款
- OTHERS: 其他
description.en:
The order type. Valid values:
- BUY: new purchase.
- UPGRADE: upgrade.
- DOWNGRADE: downgrade.
- RENEW: renewal.
- REFUND: refund.
- OTHERS: other.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh: 开始时间，与timeType结合使用。格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
description.en: The start time. This parameter is used together with TimeType. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

description.zh:
时间类型：
- 1 支付时间
- 2 下单时间
description.en:
The time type. Valid values:
- 1: payment time.
- 2: order placement time.

descriptions.zh: 调用者必须是阿里云国际站渠道总经销商伙伴或阿里云国际站渠道经销商伙伴。
descriptions.en: The caller must be an Alibaba Cloud international site channel master distributor partner or an Alibaba Cloud international site channel reseller partner.
